verdict.rationale: Devin ships a local CLI (devin) that can be invoked non-interactively with a task string, plus a full REST API for creating and managing sessions programmatically (including on behalf of users), enabling scripted/CI-driven workflows, and docs explicitly mention CI/CD integration for responding to static analysis findings. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on evidence of scripting/automation reliability, and no explicit example of a CLI flag for fully non-interactive/headless mode in scripts.
